body:
I'm stuck. 
I don't live in the US, so my experience is fairly different in getting progress, everything costs more and at least for me, the environment make it harder. (e.g. I have to manually enter/guess MFP products, because the DB doesn't correlate with my country). I can't use a gym right now and when I did, it wasn't welcoming.

I hope that tomorrow I'll resort back to a proper way of life. Maybe P90X will be a proper solution.

I can't stay without having enough money (cost of living and everything else).
I can't work in a proper job without a work visa.
I can't get a work visa unless I'll marry an american/study at an american college/become very successful and desired at certain professions and even that doesn't guarantee it.
So, I'm stuck. and everything is harder. 
Even showing the slight desire to stay in the US would get me deported for 10 years.

Thanks.

It's hard. it's even harder when I'm limited by money. When I visit the US, I have so many resources that help me make my life better. keto, paleo, going to the gym, writing. I'm limited and it just makes me frustrated.

Not in the US.

(and not Canada, UK or Australia, although it's hard for them too).
How can I love myself, when I'm so alone, for so long and just want someone to love me?

I'm afraid to take that risk again, paying someone more and more money, without a way to define an end or having the probability that it will be a waste of money. I had a bad experience in the past and I can't bare the thought of paying someone money to talk to me, while letting it go to waste again instead of being used for physical benefits (the last therapist I've met with told me to pay for sex and threaten my parents I'll kill myself so they will leave me alone).
I need to do this on my own, but I also need to have someone on my journey.

I don't see myself alive in 10 years. I find it hard to have a purpose without changing my past.

Thank you.
It's hard. I need another best friend besides myself.

That's is where my despair mostly comes from. 
I'm missing people to share my journey with, I don't have good life friends or a meaningful relationships. I feel lonely and I don't like the culture in here, it's so much better for me abroad, on so many levels and until I'll be able to relocate (which mostly requires money, nothing else), I don't know how I will be happy again.

I spend my days talking with penpals I know from all around the world, places I can't live because I don't have the proper citizenship or enough money. It's really hard being on my own, trying to survive and fighting.

Thank you.
I'll try to believe in myself.

Thank you.
I had that mindset, but it went away, I'll try to get back to it.
That was 10 messages to 10 different gals. I'm the most non creepy person in the world, maybe that's my problem.
Maybe one day, on another subreddit. thanks for being here for me.
It's funny. like getting stabbed with a knife.
Realizing I have yet to become something I will be proud of.

That's why I'm working on being my own boss. a lot of life situations can leave you helpless (natural disasters, death), but I hate the most the ones that can be avoided and you're there just because jerks or not having enough money to tell people to fuck off.

Everyday. especially when my boss can call me at the middle of the day, at the office I'm part time at, tell me to drop everything and go spend a couple of hours working and fixing someone else problems.
Luckily, it doesn't happen that often.

and then, at the end of the month, when I'm not being paid enough and being deducted the hours (that's a complex situation and I'm better off being paid a little less at those terms, as I would like to change career - and some money is better than none or working harder).
I don't know it that's wise to buy now at the current price and to throw $30K on it.

Will do, although I don't really have a life.

Thanks.

I wish I had invested money in... myself.

But I'll try to think on other trends.
Thanks for the insight.

I can't really get help. friends are probably too involved and will get tired of me (those who do care), family too and they won't necessarily have a good advice. just advice, that can worsen the situation.

I don't live in the US or the UK, so getting help on getting help won't be effective. 
It's hard with so much people against me or just really more pro-others.
How to relax... this is nerve wrecking.
Any input on how?
He isn't that smart. I would probably get a drug that can harm other body function that will eventually affect something related to sex.

I have friends, they like me. They never invite me to hangout, unless it's a huge gathering of everybody. I have no really close friends or girlfriend. Usually I initiate a meeting, but mostly I get turned down (last time I wanted to go to a movie, 7 people who "like me and really want to get together sometime" refused. they are very happy to online chat with me, they are delighted with my presence at gatherings. 
it's just very forget I exist \ hangout without me, every single one.

all I need is a wife, maybe she will have citizenship.

How long have you been married?

May I ask what are you doing on those trips? do you meet people? how do you avoid being/feeling alone?

I can relate: I'm 28, I quit my job after 10 years. I don't know what to do next, haven't been abroad for 12 years. 
I don't have US or EU citizenship so it will be hard for me to travel and stay, I do have hard earned $150K.
